officialReference.title: Autodesk MATERIAL (DXF)
officialReference.fieldsUsed: Groups 90 and 91 are unsigned 32-bit AcCmEntityColor values for ambient and diffuse colors.
officialReference.role: Normative DXF field-width/domain reference; no DWG body layout changed.

method.limitations: Typed handling is limited to MATERIAL groups 90/91 in DXF. DWG MATERIAL tail bits, specular color, maps, mapper matrices, and remaining documented fields remain unimplemented. Local round-trip evidence does not constitute native CAD semantic qualification.

implementation.integerReaderScope: ASCII unsigned values above INT32_MAX are permitted only while processing MATERIAL and only for groups 90/91. Binary I32 records retain their exact uint32 bit pattern; signed accessors and parsing remain unchanged for other contexts.
implementation.rawReplay: MATERIAL UINT32 values use INTEGER64 typed carriers; Binary output emits the original 32-bit pattern and ASCII output emits unsigned decimal, including binary-to-ASCII projection.
